steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
Peel and finely grate 1 Apple into a large bowl; squeeze out excess liquid with your hands.
Add Rolled oats, Cinnamon, and Baking powder to the bowl; stir to combine.
Add Unsweetened applesauce, 1 Egg, and Canola oil; stir until a thick, even batter forms.
Spread the batter evenly into the prepared pan, pressing it flat with a spatula.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until the top is golden and the centre feels firm to the touch.
Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then cut into 16 fingers with a sharp knife.
Serve warm or at room temperature. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
